# Copilot / Agent Project Instructions

This repository uses a unified delivery policy defined in [`/AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md).

When generating code or plans in this repo:
- Follow the role matrix and workflow in `AGENTS.md`.
- Enforce test-first release gate: do not mark task complete unless required tests pass.
- Use Conventional Commits.
- Keep each PR focused on one core logic point.

If command-line PR tooling is unavailable (for example `gh` is missing), still complete commit + push and provide a manual PR URL.
